input.args: Issue 1346: "Different mocks are used for @Mock and @InjectMocks in the same test class with JUnit 5 extension". Reporter uses MockitoExtension (Mockito 2.17.0, junit-jupiter 5.1.0) with @InjectMocks SpaceShip and @Mock TacticalStation, and asserts spaceShip.getTacticalStation() equals tacticalStation. Source checked: mockito-core InjectingAnnotationEngine.java (creates @Mock fields first, then injects one shared mock set), MockScanner.java, InjectMocksScanner.java, DefaultInjectionEngine.java, MockInjection.java. The mockito-junit-jupiter directory is not present in this checkout, so the extension code path cannot be read here.
